description:
Patrik Elias had himself a night against the Rangers, factoring in on all six Devils goals with 2 goals and 4 assists. His highlight moment came on New Jersey’s fifth tally, when he kicked the puck right onto Jamie Langenbrunner’s stick for a gorgeous setup in the slot. Elias’ Game 1 performance set the tone for the Devils’ eventual sweep of the Rangers in the 2006 playoffs. He still holds the franchise record for career assists in both the regular season and the playoffs.

description:

Zuccarello and the Rangers went on to win the game and eventually made a run all the way to the Stanley Cup Final.

description:
A clutch performer who’s won at every level, Sidney Crosby put on a show in Game 2 against Ottawa during the 2010 playoffs. With the score tied and under five minutes left, Crosby battled endlessly behind the net, protecting the puck and shaking off an Ottawa defender. He finally slipped it back to the point, where Kris Letang corralled the pass and ripped a slapshot for the game-winner. Crosby’s relentless effort and elite puck protection helped Pittsburgh earn the split on home ice, leading to a series win in six. The franchise’s all-time assists leader, Crosby also ranks inside the NHL’s Top 10 all-time in assists.
